'''[[Freedon Nadd]]'s starship''' was the vessel he used to travel to [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. Its remains were used as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] base c. [[4000 BBY/Legends|4,000 BBY.]]
